component.summary: Local-first, cent-accurate personal accounting and asset manager
本地优先、精确到分的个人记账与资产管理工具

description.p: TallyIsle is a local-first, cent-accurate personal accounting and asset management application built with Flutter, supporting multi-ledger accounting, credit card statement cycles, budgets, analytics, and portable offline backups.
帐屿是一款本地优先、精确到分的个人记账与资产管理工具，支持多账本记账、信用卡账单周期、预算统计与便携离线备份。
